notes: Repository checkpoints and implemented source files override bootstrap assumptions.
Medication inclusion is an engineering roadmap entry, not a clinical recommendation.
Clinical approval, local-policy approval, merge, deployment, and production activation remain separate human-controlled states.

statusSemantics.PLANNED: Enumerated for future engineering; authoritative source verification is still required.
statusSemantics.SOURCE_RESEARCH: Authoritative source reconciliation is pending or active.
statusSemantics.EVIDENCE_RECONCILED: Required source/evidence identity is reconciled for the scoped engineering work.
statusSemantics.IMPLEMENTED: Evidence/terminology/review wiring exists but may not yet have exact-head engineering verification.
statusSemantics.ENGINEERING_VERIFIED: Applicable schema, strict TypeScript, regression, build, and exact-head CI gates passed for the recorded scope.
statusSemantics.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Accountable clinical and/or local-policy review remains required.
statusSemantics.CLINICALLY_APPROVED: Reserved for explicit accountable clinical approval; automation must not assign it.
statusSemantics.LOCAL_POLICY_APPROVED: Reserved for explicit institutional/local-policy approval; automation must not assign it.

globalSafetyConstraints: Unknown or formulation-ambiguous medication identities fail closed to AMBIGUOUS or clinician review.
Fixed-dose combinations are whole-product identities with component ingredients preserved; they are not automatically split into independent instructions.
No patient-specific dose arithmetic, insulin conversion, anticoagulant bridging, device programming, substitution, or unsupported hold/restart timing.
Market availability is not inferred from FDA approval, DailyMed, Orange Book, or Purple Book listing alone.
New clinical content remains DRAFT/REVIEW_REQUIRED until accountable human approval.
